description: This file contains utility functions for composing visual elements into frames, including creating blank frames, drawing shapes (circles, stars), text, and gradient backgrounds. It is used for generating frames for animations or visual compositions.

methods.name: Image.Image create_blank_frame( width: int, height: int, color: tuple[int, int, int] = (255, 255, 255) )
methods.description: Creates a blank PIL image with specified width, height, and background color.

methods.name: Image.Image draw_circle( frame: Image.Image, center: tuple[int, int], radius: int, fill_color: Optional[tuple[int, int, int]] = None, outline_color: Optional[tuple[int, int, int]] = None, outline_width: int = 1, )
methods.description: Draws a circle on a given frame with specified center, radius, fill and outline colors, and outline width.

methods.name: Image.Image draw_text( frame: Image.Image, text: str, position: tuple[int, int], color: tuple[int, int, int] = (0, 0, 0), centered: bool = False, )
methods.description: Draws text on a frame at a specified position, with optional centering.

methods.name: Image.Image create_gradient_background( width: int, height: int, top_color: tuple[int, int, int], bottom_color: tuple[int, int, int], )
methods.description: Generates a vertical gradient background image from top_color to bottom_color.

methods.name: Image.Image draw_star( frame: Image.Image, center: tuple[int, int], size: int, fill_color: tuple[int, int, int], outline_color: Optional[tuple[int, int, int]] = None, outline_width: int = 1, )
methods.description: Draws a 5-pointed star on a frame at a specified center, size, fill, and optional outline.
